problem_statement: The JSON encoding library does not correctly encode a struct whose object descriptor contains an array of embedded (already-encoded) JSON object elements. When json_obj_encode is asked to serialize such a struct, the array of embedded objects is not produced correctly: the encoding either fails or yields a buffer that does not match the expected JSON text containing that array. The expected behaviour is that encoding the struct produces a JSON string that includes the array of the embedded object strings (e.g. "encoded_obj_array":[{...},{...},{...}]) matching the source struct exactly.
twister_command: scripts/twister -p native_sim/native/64 -T tests/lib/json -s tests/lib/json/libraries.encoding.json -s libraries.encoding.json -O twister-out --no-clean -W
